title: A Silent Crash Is Not a Missing Browser
description: The glyph triage gate tells a browser that never launched from one that rendered nothing by stderr signature, never by absent output. Proof 5 only grepped for the guard's identifiers; proof 6 runs a non-zero-exit, empty-stderr stub under -u CI and asserts the hard no-DOM failure. Also on board: every stale '# v6' comment on the setup-node v7.0.0 pin, rewritten to '# v7.0.0'.
